question: Are there fixed time restrictions governing recitation, worship, and offerings in this practice?
premises: Recitation is not bound by time restrictions.
Worship and similar acts are not bound by time restrictions.
Offerings are likewise not bound by time restrictions.
inference: This practice imposes no fixed time restrictions on recitation, worship, or offerings.
plain_english: In recitation there is no restriction of time, nor in worship and so forth, nor in offerings.
